title: Boundary Conditions
description: Essential Criteria - The response must correctly state the boundary conditions for the wave function at x = na.

title: Transcendental Equation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct transcendental equation relating k and K.

title: Wave Function Form
description: Important Criteria - The wave function for the region 0 <= x <= a must be correctly expressed and normalized.

title: Wave Function Behavior
description: Important Criteria - The response should explain the behavior of the wave function in the region between x = a and x = a + b.

title: Energy Gap Identification
description: Important Criteria - The student must identify the energy at which the first gap begins and provide the correct expression.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Watch for common sign mistakes in the boundary conditions or wave function expressions.

title: Normalization Issues
description: Pitfall Criteria - Look for errors in normalization of the wave function, particularly at x = 0.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Ensure that all necessary factors, such as constants or coefficients, are included in the equations.
